<div class="card-body">
'''Death Mark''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊死の烙印</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して屋外の惑星位置に配備する。相手の密輸屋を目標とする。各ターン、相手の支配フェイズの開始時に、相手は１フォースを失う。目標がウーティーニ・エフェクトに到達したら、ウーティーニ・エフェクトはキャンセルされ、目標はユーズドデッキに移される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Death-Mark-PSA-159563444.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「死の烙印を押されて生き抜くというのは、並み大抵のことじゃない。ソロ、君は優れた戦士だ。君が抜けるのは痛いよ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death brand.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on an exterior planet site. Target an opponent's smuggler. Each turn, at the start of the opponent's control phase, the opponent loses 1 Force. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, the Utinni Effect is canceled and the target is placed in the Used Pile.

'''Lore:'''
"Living with a death mark is no small thing. Solo, you're an excellent fighter. It hurts to lose you."
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Mark]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
